# Geekskai

> Geekskai is a browser-based collection of practical online tools and an Audio Toolkit for creators. The site publishes 50 utility tools across media, developer, finance, productivity, and everyday workflows.

Geekskai tools are designed to work from the browser with clear task-focused interfaces. The Audio Toolkit processes audio locally in the user's browser; uploaded media is not sent to Geekskai servers for processing.

## Product

- [Tools directory](https://geekskai.com/tools/): Browse all public online tools
- [Audio Toolkit](https://geekskai.com/audio-toolkit/): Prepare one audio file locally for free, including format conversion and two-pass LUFS normalization
- [Pricing](https://geekskai.com/pricing/): Compare Free, Basic, and Pro Audio Toolkit plans
- [Machine-readable pricing](https://geekskai.com/pricing.txt): Plain-text plan prices, limits, and current checkout availability

## Current Audio Toolkit Plans

- Free: $0; one file per local batch
- Basic: $10 monthly or $96 annually; up to 20 files per local batch and ZIP export
- Pro: $25 monthly or $240 annually; up to 50 files per local batch, ZIP export, and priority support
- Annual Basic and Pro pricing is 20% lower than paying monthly for 12 months
- Basic and Pro are recurring subscriptions available through secure PayPal Business checkout
- Each account's first successful subscription payment has one 14-day full-refund window; renewals and later subscriptions do not start a new window
- Public third-party downloader allowances remain separate free-product rules and do not change with an Audio Toolkit plan

## Popular Tools

- [VIN Decoder](https://geekskai.com/tools/vin-decoder/): Decode a vehicle identification number and view vehicle details
- [Print Test Page](https://geekskai.com/tools/print-test-page/): Generate printer test pages for color and black-and-white checks
- [Snow Day Calculator](https://geekskai.com/tools/snow-day-calculator/): Estimate the probability of a school snow day
- [Job Worth Calculator](https://geekskai.com/tools/job-worth-calculator/): Evaluate compensation and job satisfaction factors
- [SoundCloud to WAV](https://geekskai.com/tools/soundcloud-to-wav/): Convert supported SoundCloud tracks to WAV
- [Random Number Generator](https://geekskai.com/tools/random-4-digit-number-generator/): Generate random four-digit numbers

## Technical Access

- [Sitemap](https://geekskai.com/sitemap.xml): Index of canonical public pages
- [Robots](https://geekskai.com/robots.txt): Crawler access rules
- AI search crawlers including GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, and Bingbot are allowed by the current robots policy
